class.name: HTMLLabel
class.description: Displays [member document] or inline [member text] using [HTMLLayout]. Give the control a size with anchors, offsets, or a parent [Container]. The document wraps to the available width, and scrollbars appear as needed to reach overflowing content. When the active Godot accessibility backend supports it, [code]HTMLLabel[/code] publishes an element tree for headings, landmarks, links, form controls, lists, tables, dialogs, and live regions. Accessible names use [code]aria-label[/code], [code]aria-labelledby[/code], associated [code]<label>[/code] text, image [code]alt[/code], and native text where available. Disabled, required, read-only, checked, selected, invalid, and expanded states are exposed where Godot has a matching state. Focus, click, and scroll actions are routed back to the HTML document. Godot does not provide dedicated heading or landmark roles, so those use static-text or container roles with role descriptions. Elements hidden by [code]hidden[/code], [code]inert[/code], [code]aria-hidden="true"[/code], or computed [code]display:none[/code] are omitted. The default canvas follows CSS [code]color-scheme[/code]. Set an HTML background with CSS, or enable [member transparent_canvas] to composite it over the scene. Source changes are applied on a deferred update and reset the scroll position. Resizing recalculates the layout and clamps the current scroll offset. Clicking a [code]#id[/code] link scrolls to the matching HTML element. Connect [signal link_pressed] to handle other links. Drag to select rendered text. The focused control supports the standard select-all and copy shortcuts. CSS [code]::selection[/code] styles the selection highlight. Selection drags and elements with [code]draggable="true"[/code] expose [code]text/plain[/code], serialized [code]text/html[/code], and custom MIME data through [HTMLDataTransfer]. Drop HTML into an editable region in another [HTMLLabel], or drop the plain text into Godot controls such as [LineEdit]. For rich-text editing, mark a region [code]contenteditable="true"[/code] or [code]contenteditable="plaintext-only"[/code]. The document node also exposes [member HTMLDocumentNode.design_mode] and [member HTMLDocumentNode.active_element]. The focused editable region supports basic text insertion, deletion, line breaks, and [method execute_edit_command] formatting commands. It does not yet provide browser-equivalent IME handling or HTML clipboard paste. CSS [code]:hover[/code] matches the element under the mouse and its ancestors. Scrolling updates the hovered element even when the mouse is stationary. During text selection by dragging, hover styles stay fixed until the drag ends. Elements also report DOM events. Register a listener with [method HTMLEventTarget.add_event_listener] or [method HTMLEventTarget.listen] on an element, document, or window. Events run before the built-in action they describe, so a listener can call [method HTMLEvent.prevent_default] to cancel following a link, activating a button or label, toggling a checkbox, opening a disclosure or dropdown, editing text, traversing focus with Tab, and submitting or resetting a form. Pointer moves are coalesced per frame; wheel dispatch stays synchronous. Events without listeners change nothing, and the signals below keep reporting the actions that were performed. Assign a Callable to an event handler property such as [code]element.onclick[/code], or use an HTML [code]on*[/code] attribute that names a GDScript behavior method as [code]_on_click()[/code] or [code]_on_click(event)[/code]. Callable properties override the corresponding attribute handler. This does not execute JavaScript. When a listener cancels an event, the signal that reports the same action is not emitted. For example, cancelling [code]click[/code] on a link suppresses [signal link_pressed]. CSS [code]cursor[/code] supports [code]default[/code], [code]pointer[/code], [code]text[/code], [code]crosshair[/code], [code]move[/code], [code]wait[/code], [code]progress[/code], [code]help[/code], [code]not-allowed[/code], [code]ew-resize[/code], and [code]ns-resize[/code]. With [code]auto[/code] or unsupported values, the control uses a pointing hand over links, an I-beam when text selection is enabled, and an arrow otherwise. Dragging to select text uses the I-beam. [code]<button type="button">[/code] has a default style that author CSS can override. Use [code]:active[/code], [code]:focus[/code], [code]:focus-visible[/code], [code]:enabled[/code], and [code]:disabled[/code] to style its states. Enter and Space activate the focused button even when text selection is disabled. Connect [signal button_pressed] to handle commands in GDScript. Read the button's [code]id[/code] or [code]data-*[/code] attributes to identify the command. Tab and Shift+Tab traverse visible, enabled inputs, buttons, links with an [code]href[/code], and elements with a valid [code]tabindex[/code]. Positive values are visited in ascending order before the default stops. A negative value allows direct focus. At either end, focus passes to another Godot control when one is available. HTML inputs are represented by [HTMLInputElement]. A focused text input handles text editing, its own selection, and system IME composition. A focused checkbox can be toggled with Space. Date, time, color, and file inputs provide pickers. Focused text fields support the [code]ui_undo[/code] and [code]ui_redo[/code] input actions. Undo and redo also restore the selection. Each IME commit is grouped into one edit. Assigning a new value from script or resetting the form clears the field's edit history.

method.name: reload_components
method.description: Unmounts component instances and schedules registration and mounting again.

method.name: get_component_diagnostics
method.description: Returns component registration failures with tag, src, and reason fields.

method.name: get_base_uri
method.description: Returns the effective base URL of the displayed document. See [method HTMLLayout.get_base_uri].

method.name: back
method.description: Loads the previous entry in this label's navigation history. Returns [code]false[/code] when there is no previous entry.

method.name: forward
method.description: Loads the next entry in this label's navigation history. Returns [code]false[/code] when there is no next entry.

method.name: get_behavior_diagnostics
method.description: Returns a snapshot of behavior mounting failures. Each Dictionary contains [code]src[/code], [code]path[/code], and [code]reason[/code]. Failures are also reported with [code]push_warning[/code].

method.name: get_location
method.description: Returns the current navigation URL, or the effective document base URL when no navigation has occurred.

method.name: get_storage_namespace
method.description: Returns the configured storage namespace, or the document source and host identity used by persistent behavior storage.

method.name: go
method.description: Moves by [param delta] entries in this label's navigation history. Returns [code]false[/code] when the target is outside the history or is the current entry.

method.name: activate_element
method.description: Activates a visible link or a form control in this label. A fragment link requests an anchor scroll before emitting [signal link_pressed]. A command button emits [signal button_pressed]. Form buttons, labels, toggles, and dropdowns perform their corresponding actions. Returns [code]true[/code] if activation was dispatched.

method.name: advance_animation
method.description: Applies pending layout changes and advances CSS animations and transitions by [param delta] seconds while this label is in the scene tree. The delta must be finite and non-negative. Pass [code]0.0[/code] to apply pending changes at the current time. In Idle or Physics mode, this step adds to automatic updates.

method.name: focus_element
method.description: Focuses a visible, enabled element from this label and scrolls it into view. Returns [code]false[/code] if the element cannot receive focus.

method.name: get_focused_element
method.description: Returns the focused element, or [code]null[/code] when the label has no DOM focus. Removing the focused element from the document clears focus and ends input method composition immediately. Reinserting it does not restore focus.

method.name: clear_selection
method.description: Clears the text selection.

method.name: get_document_node
method.description: Returns the root node of this control's live document, or [code]null[/code] when the source has not been parsed yet. Register listeners on this node to handle events for all of its descendants, then use [method HTMLElement.closest] on the event's [member HTMLEvent.target] to find the element that owns the action. The handle is invalidated when the source is reparsed.

method.name: create_document_fragment
method.description: Creates an empty fragment owned by this control's layout. See [method HTMLLayout.create_document_fragment].

method.name: create_element
get_content_size
method.description: Returns the laid-out document size in pixels. Returns [constant Vector2i.ZERO] when there is no valid layout or the document is empty.

method.name: get_element_at
method.description: Returns the element at the given position in this control's local coordinates. The scroll offset is applied automatically. Returns [code]null[/code] outside the content viewport, including the scrollbars, and when there is no hit or the layout is pending.

method.name: get_element_by_id
method.description: Looks up a case-sensitive HTML ID in this label's parsed document. See [method HTMLLayout.get_element_by_id].

method.name: get_css_diagnostics
method.description: Returns a copy of the CSS diagnostics for the current layout. See [method HTMLLayout.get_css_diagnostics] for the dictionary fields.

method.name: get_render_error
method.description: Returns the latest parsing or layout error, or an empty string on success. Errors are also shown in the editor as node configuration warnings.

method.name: get_scroll_offset
method.description: Returns the horizontal and vertical scroll offset in pixels from the start of the document.

method.name: get_accessible_text
method.description: Returns the document text published as this control's accessibility text value. CSS alternatives in [code]content[/code] are applied. See [method HTMLLayout.get_accessible_text].

method.name: get_selected_text
method.description: Returns the selected plain text, or an empty string if nothing is selected.

method.name: query_selector
method.description: Returns the first match in this label's parsed document. See [method HTMLLayout.query_selector].

method.name: query_selector_all
method.description: Returns all matches in this label's parsed document. See [method HTMLLayout.query_selector_all].

method.name: navigate
method.description: Loads a local HTML file or an HTTP(S) HTML page and adds it to this label's navigation history. Set [param replace] to replace the current history entry. Navigating to a fragment in the current document scrolls to its anchor without adding an entry. Remote page loading is asynchronous; connect to [signal navigation_failed] to handle failures.

method.name: reload_behaviors
method.description: Detaches and remounts behaviors declared in the current document. Resource-path scripts are reloaded from the resource cache before mounting.

method.name: scroll_to_anchor
method.description: Scrolls to a laid-out element by its case-sensitive HTML ID. Pass the ID without [code]#[/code]. Alignment follows [method scroll_to_element], including CSS scroll padding and margins. Each scroll container uses its own [code]scroll-behavior[/code]. Returns [code]false[/code] if the ID is absent or the layout is pending.

method.name: scroll_to_element
method.description: Scrolls to an element obtained from this label, starting with its innermost scroll container. [param align] places the top of the target's CSS scroll margin area from [code]0.0[/code] at the top of the scroll-padding region to [code]1.0[/code] at its bottom, within the scrollable range. Horizontal scrolling adjusts when the area's left edge is outside that region. Returns [code]false[/code] for an invalid or foreign element, an element without a visible layout box, or a pending layout.

method.name: select_all
method.description: Selects all text in the document.

method.name: set_scroll_offset
method.description: Sets the horizontal and vertical scroll offset in pixels, clamped to the scrollable range. If a layout is pending, the offset is applied after that layout.

method.name: submit_form
method.description: Submits a connected form in this label and emits [signal form_submitted] on success. An optional submitter must be an enabled submit button associated with the form. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] on failed validation or [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for an invalid argument. The submitter's [code]formmethod[/code] overrides the form's [code]method[/code]. With the [code]dialog[/code] method, a successful submission closes the form's nearest ancestor [HTMLDialogElement]. A supplied submitter [code]value[/code], including an empty string, replaces [member HTMLDialogElement.return_value]. Omit the attribute or the submitter to preserve the existing value.

method.name: get_elements_at
method.description: Returns the elements under a label-local point in front-to-back hit order. Scrollbars and points outside the visible document are skipped.

method.name: get_plain_text
method.description: Returns the indexed document text used for selection and search.

method.name: get_selection_range
method.description: Returns the ordered selection endpoints as offsets into [method get_plain_text].

method.name: set_selection_range
method.description: Sets the document selection using character offsets. Endpoints are clamped to the document text length.

method.name: get_selection_rects
method.description: Returns the visible selection rectangles in document coordinates.

method.name: copy_selection
method.description: Copies selectable text to the system clipboard. Returns whether there was text to copy.

method.name: find_text
method.description: Searches document text from the given offset and returns the matching range, or [code]Vector2i(-1, -1)[/code] when absent.

method.name: scroll_element_into_view
method.description: Scrolls inner containers and the viewport to reveal an element. Options are [code]block[/code], [code]inline[/code], and [code]behavior[/code]. The alignment values are [code]start[/code], [code]center[/code], [code]end[/code], and [code]nearest[/code]. Behavior accepts [code]auto[/code], [code]instant[/code], or [code]smooth[/code]. The defaults are [code]start[/code], [code]nearest[/code], and [code]auto[/code].

method.name: scroll_to_text_range
method.description: Scrolls the viewport to the first available selection rectangle for character offsets [param from] and [param to]. Returns [code]false[/code] if the range has no visible rectangle in the laid-out document.

method.name: create_range
method.description: Creates a live range with both endpoints at the start of the DOM document.

method.name: execute_edit_command
method.description: Applies a supported formatting command to a noncollapsed selection inside the focused editable region. Commands include [code]bold[/code], [code]italic[/code], [code]underline[/code], [code]strikethrough[/code], [code]subscript[/code], [code]superscript[/code], [code]formatBlock[/code], [code]insertOrderedList[/code], [code]insertUnorderedList[/code], [code]createLink[/code], [code]foreColor[/code], and [code]backColor[/code]. Dispatches cancelable [code]beforeinput[/code] and [code]input[/code] events. Returns [code]false[/code] for unsupported commands or an invalid selection.

method.name: get_selection
method.description: Returns the live document selection, or [code]null[/code] if the document is unavailable.

method.name: get_computed_style
method.description: Returns a snapshot of serialized computed CSS properties. Lengths that depend on a layout box can retain percentages. See [method HTMLElement.get_bounding_rect] for geometry.

method.name: get_computed_style_property
method.description: Returns a serialized computed value for a connected element, including sampled animation values. Pass [code]::before[/code], [code]::after[/code], [code]::marker[/code], [code]::placeholder[/code], [code]::selection[/code], or [code]::backdrop[/code] to inspect a supported pseudo-element. Returns an empty string if the value is unavailable.

method.name: get_stylesheets
method.description: Returns the author stylesheets in source order. Each dictionary includes [code]id[/code], [code]owner[/code], [code]source[/code], [code]path[/code], [code]media[/code], and [code]disabled[/code]. The additional stylesheet is last. IDs apply to the current layout generation.

method.name: get_css_rules
method.description: Returns a serialized snapshot of the top-level rules in the stylesheet identified by [param stylesheet]. Grouped and imported rules retain their place in the list.

method.name: insert_rule
method.description: Inserts one CSS rule at the given zero-based index. The edit applies to this layout. Invalid rules or indices leave the stylesheet as it was.

method.name: delete_rule
method.description: Deletes the top-level rule at the given zero-based index in this layout.

method.name: supports_css
method.description: Tests a CSS property and value, or a [code]@supports[/code] condition when [param value] is empty.

method.name: supports_selector
method.description: Tests whether the selector is accepted by the CSS selector parser.

method.name: matches_media
method.description: Tests the media query against the current CSS viewport and preferences.

method.name: get_animations
method.description: Returns CSS animations, CSS transitions, and scripted animations. Pass an element to restrict the snapshot to that target.

method.name: animate
method.description: Creates a scripted animation on the current layout clock. Keyframe dictionaries contain CSS property values and optional [code]offset[/code] and [code]easing[/code]. Options include [code]duration[/code], [code]delay[/code], [code]iterations[/code], [code]easing[/code], [code]direction[/code], and [code]fill[/code]. Times are in seconds. Returns [code]null[/code] for invalid input or an empty effect.

method.name: get_fullscreen_video
method.description: Returns the current fullscreen video owned by this label, if any.

method.name: get_event_listener_count
method.description: Returns the number of explicit listeners registered for [param type] on this label's document, elements, and window. Event handler properties and HTML attributes are not included.

members.member: Maps custom HTML tag names to HTMLComponent scripts. Valid document declarations take precedence. Enable behaviors_enabled to run components.

Chooses when CSS animations and transitions advance. Idle uses the idle frame delta, Physics uses the physics frame delta, and Manual uses calls to [method advance_animation]. Switching modes preserves the current progress and any remaining delay.
The base directory in [code]res://[/code] or [code]user://[/code] for relative asset paths in [member text]. See [method HTMLLayout.parse] for the supported paths and image formats.

A [code]Dictionary[StringName, GDScript][/code] of optional [HTMLBehavior] aliases. A script element first selects an exact [code]src[/code] alias; otherwise [code]src[/code] is resolved as a local script path. Reading this property returns a copy. Assign a new dictionary to update the registry and remount behaviors.

Enables local and registered [HTMLBehavior] scripts at runtime. Network script URLs are rejected. Replacing the document, disabling behaviors, or leaving the scene tree detaches current instances and cancels their asynchronous work.
If [code]true[/code], the caret in a focused text field blinks. If [code]false[/code], it stays visible while the field is focused.
The time in seconds between changes in caret visibility when [member caret_blink] is enabled.

Shows an editing menu for text inputs and textareas on right-click or with the [code]ui_menu[/code] input action. Opening the menu commits any pending IME text as one undoable edit. Readonly fields offer Copy and Select All. Keyboard editing shortcuts remain available when the menu is disabled.
Outlines visible elements with CSS declaration diagnostics. Hover over an outlined element to read its diagnostics in an HTML tooltip. Disabling this clears the outlines and results.
The HTML resource to display. Its source and styles take priority over the local properties. Set this to [code]null[/code] to use [member text], [member base_dir], and [member stylesheet].
Prints a summary of each DOM event dispatched by this label, including its target, propagation path size, registered listener count, and default-canceled state.
The current navigation URL. Read-only.
Persistent behavior storage namespace. When empty, the label derives one from its document source or node identity.
Enables text selection. Disabling it clears the current selection.
Additional CSS for [member text]. The rules share the document stylesheets' author origin and follow them in source order. See [method HTMLLayout.parse].
The HTML document or fragment to display.
If [code]true[/code], the default canvas is transparent. Authored CSS backgrounds still paint over the scene.
The audio bus used by audio elements. An unavailable bus name uses the current backend's Master bus.
Uses the FMOD audio player and bus list when the optional FMOD plugin is available.
The video decoder. Auto tries the available FFmpeg and VLC add-ons in that order for each source.
The Godot audio bus for video playback.

signal.name: button_pressed
signal.description: Emitted when an enabled [code]<button type="button">[/code] is activated by a mouse click, Enter, Space, or [method activate_element]. Pressing and releasing over different descendants of the same button can activate it. The signal passes an [HTMLButtonElement] handle.

signal.name: element_clicked
signal.description: Emitted when a left mouse press and release hit the same visible HTML element without dragging or scrolling. Use [method HTMLElement.closest] to find an ancestor with an action attribute. For a link, the built-in anchor scroll and [signal link_pressed] run first. The element signal is emitted if the target still belongs to the current document.

signal.name: form_reset
signal.description: Emitted after a reset button restores the form's default values.

signal.name: form_submitted
signal.description: Emitted for a valid submission with ordered entries and the submitter. The submitter is an [HTMLButtonElement], an [HTMLInputElement], or [code]null[/code]. If the submission closes a dialog, this signal is emitted before [signal HTMLDialogElement.closed].

signal.name: form_validation_failed
signal.description: Emitted with the first control that fails form validation.

signal.name: input_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the user changes an input value or checked state. Read the new state from the element.

signal.name: input_committed
signal.description: Emitted when the user confirms an edit. Text fields commit with Enter or on focus loss. Toggle controls and confirmed picker selections commit immediately after [signal input_changed].

signal.name: layout_changed
signal.description: Emitted after a deferred layout update, when the new content size and scroll range can be queried. Multiple element edits before the update are combined. The signal also reports a cleared or failed layout and reflow caused by hover styles.

signal.name: link_pressed
signal.description: Emitted when the left mouse button is pressed and released over the same visible link without dragging or scrolling, when Enter activates a focused link, or when [method activate_element] activates a link. [param uri] is the link's original nonempty [code]href[/code].

signal.name: location_changed
signal.description: Emitted after a navigation or history traversal changes the current URL.

signal.name: navigation_failed
signal.description: Emitted when a local or remote page cannot be loaded.

signal.name: select_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a user selects a different option in a dropdown.

signal.name: textarea_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the user changes the value of a multiline text field.

signal.name: textarea_committed
signal.description: Emitted when a multiline text field loses focus after a user edit.

signal.name: video_failed
signal.description: Emitted when a video cannot open any of its sources.

signal.name: video_fullscreen_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the video enters or exits fullscreen.

constants.constant: Advances CSS animations and transitions during idle processing.
Advances CSS animations and transitions during physics processing.
Advances CSS animations and transitions through calls to [method advance_animation].
Selects an available video decoder automatically.
